gaps.explanation: Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds, p9 (Electric Fund, Sewer Fund) and p10 (Natural Gas Fund, Water Fund, Allocated Administration, Total); printed p21 across two pages. No enterprise schedule exists and detail[] has no business-type lines. JSON receipts (Total column) = total operating revenues 5,743,292 + Interest income 15,965 + Grant revenue 1,213,477 + Gain on sale of capital assets 30,860 + Miscellaneous income 3,116 = 7,006,710. Per column: Electric 1,546,340 + 542,848 + 31,821 + 651,914 + 392,051 + 72,546 = 3,237,520; Sewer 464,478 + 48,300 + 559,352 + 30,860 = 1,102,990; Natural Gas 551,357 + 409,893 + 9,211 + 61,686 + 429,827 + 17,693 + 115,271 = 1,594,938; Water 156,951 + 87,791 + 23,930 + 197,210 + 4,536 + 528,956 = 999,374; Allocated Administration 42,909 + 15,965 + 9,898 + 3,116 = 71,888. Sum 7,006,710. After fix: 0 + 7,006,710 = 7,006,710. The 'Allocated Administration' column is printed under the Enterprise Funds heading and carries part of every total, so it is added under its printed heading. Governmental other financing (p5) prints only transfers.

gaps.explanation: Same statement pp9-10. JSON disbursements = Total column operating expenses 5,115,124 + Interest expense 5,982 + Loan administration fees 2,865 = 5,123,971 (Total column prints '-' for 'Allocated administrative expenses'). Per column total operating expenses as printed: Electric 2,688,248 (incl. allocated 295,098); Sewer 562,665 (incl. allocated 43,588); Natural Gas 1,327,060 (incl. allocated 137,145); Water 474,110 (incl. allocated 43,069); Allocated Administration 63,041 (incl. Allocated administrative expenses (518,900)) plus Interest expense 5,982 and Loan administration fees 2,865. The allocation cells net to zero (295,098 + 43,588 + 137,145 + 43,069 - 518,900 = 0) and are kept as printed. Sum 2,688,248 + 562,665 + 1,327,060 + 474,110 + 63,041 + 5,982 + 2,865 = 5,123,971. After fix: 0 + 5,123,971 = 5,123,971.
